title: RTO/RPO gap analysis
description: Validates that disaster recovery configurations meet stated RTO/RPO targets for each critical workload.
example_prompt: "For all resources tagged 'Tier=Critical', assess DR posture: (1) is backup configured? frequency vs RPO target, (2) is geo-replication enabled? (3) replication lag vs RPO, (4) is there a failover plan? last DR drill date. Flag workloads where configured RPO > stated RPO target or no DR mechanism exists."
